chunks: And Dāwūd ibn Kathīr al-Raqqī narrated from him that he said:
"Indeed, all people live in the surplus of the wrong done to us, except that we have made that permissible for our Shīʿah."

key_terms.فِي فَضْلِ: from the excess or surplus of
key_terms.مَظْلِمَتِنَا: the injustice or wrong done to us

ai.seo_question: What does the hadith about people living from the wrong done to the Ahl al-Bayt عليهم السلام mean in relation to khums?
ai.summary: This hadith states that people benefit from what is connected to the usurped rights of the Ahl al-Bayt عليهم السلام. It also declares that the Imams عليهم السلام made this matter permissible for their Shīʿah, which is significant in discussions of khums and the financial rights of the Ahl al-Bayt عليهم السلام.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1662 - It is narrated from Dawud ibn Kathir al-Riqqi that Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said:
"Indeed, all people live off the remnants of the injustice done to us, except that we have made it permissible for our Shia."
